display.purpose: Portada name between stacked hairlines; interior nameplate is the same face at weight 400.

headline.purpose: Page h1 on contacto and every proyecto page; portada feature h2.

title.purpose: Section heads and story part heads.

row.purpose: Story row and directory list titles.

body.purpose: Running text, descriptions, ficha values; subpage body uses old-style figures.

label.purpose: Folios, datelines, nav, chips, buttons, field keys; uppercase, tabular figures.

motion.name: entrance-rise
motion.value: opacity 0 to 1, translateY(12px) to 0, 220ms ease-out, 0–240ms delays
motion.purpose: The portada's single authored .rise stagger; pure CSS so content renders with JS off.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Hover, focus and color/background state changes on both sheets; skip link slides 0.15s.

components.name: Primary Button (Ink)
components.description: Primary action: ink fill inverting to red-deep on hover — subpage nav CTA and stacked stamp actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { display: inline-block; background: #ece8df; color: #121110; border: 1px solid #ece8df; border-radius: 0; padding: 9px 18px; font-family: "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ink:hover { background: #f2564d; border-color: #f2564d; color: #160b0a; } .ds-btn-ink:active { background: #e5473f; border-color: #e5473f; color: #160b0a; } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e5473f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Accent Button (Signal Red)
components.description: The single red CTA — the portada's 'Hablemos'; hover flips to paper-light stock.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-block; background: #e5473f; color: #160b0a; border: 1px solid #e5473f; border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: #f2efe7; border-color: #f2efe7; color: #121110; } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e5473f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Outlined secondary action; inverts to ink fill on hover like everything else in the paper.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-block; background: transparent; color: #ece8df; border: 1px solid #ece8df; border-radius: 0; padding: 9px 18px; font-family: "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #ece8df; color: #121110; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e5473f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Composer field on contacto: raised stock, 1px ink frame, serif text, red-deep focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field-key { display: block; color: #ece8df; font-family: "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-field-input { display: block; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; background: #1b1a17; color: #ece8df; border: 1px solid #ece8df; border-radius: 0; padding: 10px 12px; font-family: "Source Serif 4", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1rem; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: #9b958a; opacity: 1; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f2564d; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Outlined label chip with tabular figures — stack tags, story indices, meta marks.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: transparent; color: #ece8df; border: 1px solid #ece8df; border-radius: 0; padding: 3px 8px; font-family: "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Live Chip
components.description: Signal-red fill for live/current state — the only filled chip in the system.
components.css: .ds-chip-live { display: inline-block; background: #e5473f; color: #160b0a; border: 1px solid #e5473f; border-radius: 0; padding: 3px 8px; font-family: "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Directory Row
components.description: Whole-row link on subpages: 1px rule base, inverts to ink-on-ground on hover with focus kept inside the row.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 14px 8px; background: #121110; color: #ece8df; border-bottom: 1px solid #4a473f; border-radius: 0; font-family: "Source Serif 4", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-row-note { font-family: "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9b958a; transition: color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-row:hover { background: #ece8df; color: #121110; } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-note { color: #121110; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e5473f; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Interior Nameplate
components.description: Centered wordless flag on subpages, linked home; goes signal red on hover like every subpage link.
components.css: .ds-nameplate { display: block; text-align: center; color: #ece8df; font-family: "Source Serif 4", Georgia, serif; font-size: clamp(2.1rem, 7vw, 3.4rem); font-weight: 400; line-height: 0.96; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-nameplate:hover { color: #f2564d; } .ds-nameplate:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f2564d; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.description: Accessibility bar parked above the fold (top -48px), sliding in on focus in label face.
components.css: .ds-skip { position: fixed; top: -48px; left: 8px; z-index: 100; background: #ece8df; color: #121110; border-radius: 0; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: "Archivo Narrow", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: top 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-skip:focus { top: 8px; } .ds-skip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e5473f; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Nocturno prints the portfolio as the night edition of a paper of record: warm near-black stock instead of newsprint grey, warm off-white ink, one signal-red spot, and hairline rules doing the structural work that boxes and shadows do elsewhere. Projects are reported stories — folio lines, datelines, bylines, decks, fichas and plates carry the furniture — and the whole paper is set in two faces: Source Serif 4 for every display and reading line, Archivo Narrow for every label, key, chip and control.

Density is editorial rather than app-like: sections meet on 1px rules, rows pad 12–17px, corners are square everywhere, and the page answers touch with inversion or a warm tint instead of lift. The system is deliberately flat and deliberately dark; the only chroma is red, and it only ever means something — live, focus, current, one CTA. It refuses the category default of a centered hero over a grid of rounded cards, and it refuses elevation theatre: no radius, no shadow, no glow.

This file records the shipped Nocturno build (the portada's inline style sheet plus assets/css/press.css for every subpage); the earlier light-newsprint and timing-tower editions are superseded.
keyCharacteristics: Night-edition stock: warm near-black ground (#121110) with warm off-white ink (#ece8df); color-scheme: dark on every page.
One spot color: signal red (#e5473f) marks state, emphasis and the primary CTA — nowhere else.
Two faces: Source Serif 4 (variable, weights 200–900, roman + italic) and Archivo Narrow (400/700), both served as local woff2 from assets/fonts/.
Rule-built: sections, rows, frames and masthead bands are 1px hairlines; zero radius, zero shadows.
Editorial furniture: folio, dateline, byline, deck, ficha, plates, colophon and stamp as the component language.
Restrained motion: one staggered rise on the portada, 120–150ms state transitions, prefers-reduced-motion honored on both sheets.

rules.name: The Single-Spot Rule
rules.body: One spot color. Red marks state (live, focus, current), emphasis and a single primary CTA; it never fills a section or a page. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Two-Face Rule
rules.body: Two faces ship: Source Serif 4 sets every display and reading line, Archivo Narrow sets every label, key, chip and control. No third face — not for numbers, not for UI; serif tabular/old-style figures carry data instead of a mono.

rules.name: The Short-Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is a voice for short labels only — folios, datelines, nav, chips, keys, buttons — always letter-spaced (0.04em–0.12em; 0.1em is the Nocturno chrome value, 0.12em the portada slugs). Long metadata lines drop to mixed case at 0.04em tracking.

rules.name: The Flat-Print Rule
rules.body: Surfaces print flat. Hover flips ink and paper or warms the row one tint step; it never lifts, glows, or blurs.

rules.name: The Square-Corner Rule
rules.body: Radius is 0 everywhere. A rounded corner would break the cut-paper silhouette; framing is done with hairlines, never with soft corners.

rules.name: The Inversion Rule
rules.body: Hover answers in stock, not in space: interior rows and buttons flip ink and paper, the portada warms the row to raised ground and sets the title red. Nothing lifts, glows, or rounds.

dos: Do keep every assignment inside the two-face system: Source Serif 4 for display and reading, Archivo Narrow for labels and controls (0.6875rem–0.8125rem, uppercase, 0.04em–0.12em).
Do keep short labels uppercase and long metadata lines mixed-case at 0.04em — the portada's meta and colophon lines do exactly this.
Do frame tools, images and panels with 1px borders (ink on raised ground; rule/rule-soft for divisions) and separate sections with full-width 1px rules.
Do answer hover with inversion or one warm tint step in 120–150ms, and keep focus visible as the 2px red ring.
Do keep both language states typographically identical — data-en swaps words, never styles.
Do use tabular figures for folios, indices, chips and ficha values; subpage running text keeps old-style figures.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion on every surface (both stylesheets implement it).
donts: Don't introduce a third typeface or a mono for numbers — two faces, and serif tabular/old-style figures carry data.
Don't add border-radius anywhere; every shipped corner is square (0).
Don't add box-shadow, glow or blur to any surface or state — depth is tint, rule and inversion.
Don't set wide-tracked uppercase on sentences or long metadata lines; that tracking belongs to short labels.
Don't use signal red as a section or page fill — it marks state, emphasis and one CTA.
Don't ship looping, parallax or scroll-hijacked motion; the only entrance is the portada's single staggered rise.
